info.title: Agency Tracking API
info.description: Labor-recruitment/placement platform (Ethiopia -> Saudi Arabia / Kuwait corridors) API surface. Every endpoint is a whitelisted Frappe method under /api/method/agency_tracking.*, mediated by its own explicit permission check -- there is no raw /api/resource/* access to any doctype in this app (see agency_tracking/CLAUDE.md Part F). Roles referenced under x-roles on each operation are the custom roles defined in agency_tracking/roles.py; see the full list below.

sessionCookie.name: Cookie
sessionCookie.description: Session-cookie auth for everyone (staff and agencies), per Part F: 'Auth: session-cookie for everyone.' Obtained via POST /api/method/login.

csrfToken.name: X-Frappe-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required on every state-changing (POST) request once logged in. Fetch via agency_tracking.auth_api.get_csrf_token.

post.summary: Cancel an Applicant (global escape hatch)
post.description: Only from Registered/CV Generated. If an active_placement exists, freezes it and every linked Clearance Step to Cancelled first, then cancels the Applicant itself. Never bumps cycle_number by itself -- only a later restart does.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Written reason, required

post.summary: Open a new Applicant file at Draft
post.description: Draft floor: full_name, gender, nationality, entry_track. Accepts any other Applicant field as additional form data. Names are stored in ALL CAPS: first_name/middle_name/last_name/full_name/place_of_birth/passport_issue_place are uppercased and whitespace-collapsed on every save, and full_name is always rebuilt from first/middle/last when any part is set (a sent full_name is only kept when there are no parts).

parameters.name: nationality
parameters.description: Country link

post.description: Full doc as dict.

post.description: backend-issues #02: whitelisted replacement for the raw /api/resource/Applicant fallback. Enforces the doctype's own permissions (Registrar, Manager, Admin, System Manager, Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, and the six country+step roles). Paging (2026-09-23): limit_start / limit_page_length (max 500) / with_total.

post.summary: Set a permanent per-(Applicant, Country) ban
post.description: backend-issues #08: previously no whitelisted writer existed for Applicant Country Ban -- the doctype's own permissions already grant create to Registrar/Complaint Manager/Manager/Admin/System Manager.

post.summary: List country bans, optionally scoped to one Applicant
post.description: Active bans only by default; pass active_only=0 to include lifted ones (ban history). Each row: name, applicant, country, active, set_by, set_on, reason, lifted_by, lifted_on, lift_reason.

post.summary: Lift a country ban
post.description: Lifts (deactivates) the ban rather than deleting it: the row stays with active=0 plus lifted_by/lifted_on/lift_reason, so ban history is auditable. Manager/Admin/System Manager only (write permission) -- Registrar/Complaint Manager can set a ban but not lift one. Pass ban_name, or applicant_name + country to lift that pair's active ban.

parameters.name: ban_name
parameters.description: ACB-xxxxx. Either this or applicant_name + country.

parameters.name: lift_reason
parameters.description: Why the ban is being lifted; stored on the row and sent in the Manager notification

417.description: Neither ban_name nor applicant_name + country given

post.description: Sets fee_status=Paid and saves -- Applicant.maybe_log_fee_transaction then creates the actual Pending Applicant Transaction in the same save. Requires fee_required + registration_fee_amount already set; throws if this fee was already logged.
x-roles: Any internal staff role (Registrar, Clearance Officer, Ticketer, Finance Manager, Manager, Admin, etc.)

Refused (403) if the applicant has an active country ban on their destination_country, unless a Manager/Admin overrides or an approved Country Ban Request pass exists (see request_country_ban_exception).

parameters.name: override_reason

post.description: Cancelled -> Draft or Registered. cycle_number bumps automatically. Restarting straight to Registered fails naturally if the field floor isn't actually satisfied. Refused (403) if the applicant has an active country ban on their destination_country, unless a Manager/Admin overrides or an approved Country Ban Request pass exists -- checked on every restart, since this is how a cancelled applicant re-enters the pipeline.

parameters.name: override_ban
parameters.description: Manager/Admin/System Manager only, to push past an active country ban on the applicant's destination_country

parameters.name: override_reason
parameters.description: Required if override_ban is true

post.summary: Edit an Applicant at Draft or Registered
post.description: Does not change status -- use register_applicant for that. If entry_track changes while Registered/CV Generated, forces a regression to Draft first (cycle_number bumps automatically). A destination_country that differs from the current one is checked against active Applicant Country Bans (re-submitting the unchanged country is not re-checked, so routine edits of a banned applicant still save). Names are stored in ALL CAPS: first_name/middle_name/last_name/full_name/place_of_birth/passport_issue_place are uppercased and whitespace-collapsed on every save, and full_name is always rebuilt from first/middle/last when any part is set (a sent full_name is only kept when there are no parts).

parameters.name: override_ban
parameters.description: Manager/Admin/System Manager only, to push past a country ban

parameters.name: override_reason
parameters.description: Required if override_ban is true

post.summary: Mark a Clearance Step complete/Issued
post.description: Not for Embassy steps. LMIS (both countries) completes to 'Issued'; everything else (Taeshir, Telesign) completes to the generic 'Complete'. Legal from Pending or In Progress (a fresh completion); re-calling it on an already-terminal step is treated as a correction (reference_no/amount/date_completed only, status/completed_by are refreshed but the outcome itself doesn't change) -- any other from-status is rejected (417). Blocked entirely once the parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled.
x-roles: Anyone holding the role mapped to this step_type (Saudi LMIS, Saudi Taeshir, Kuwait LMIS, Kuwait Telesign)

parameters.name: date_completed
parameters.description: Only applied when explicitly passed. Defaults to today on a fresh completion; left untouched on a correction that doesn't pass it.

post.summary: Reopen a Clearance Step's own terminal outcome
post.description: New (2026-09-12). Manager/Admin/System Manager only. Reverses a step's own terminal outcome (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) back to Pending/In Progress (or Submitted, Embassy only) when the determination itself was wrong, not just its data -- complete_clearance_step's own correction path already covers a wrong reference number/amount/date on an otherwise-correct outcome. Deliberately scoped to only this step: does not cascade into anything downstream (Embassy work already done on the old result, or a Placement that already auto-advanced to Stamped) -- the Stamped->Ticketed gate separately re-checks that every mandatory step is still complete before Ticketing, so a reopened step blocks progress until it's re-completed rather than being silently ignored. Also recreates task visibility (2026-09-12): whoever originally completed the step gets their own ToDo back, and every current holder of the step_type's mapped role gets a fresh broadcast ToDo, the same as when the step was first created -- its original ToDo was already closed at completion time, so without this the reopened step would silently have no one's queue pointing at it.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Mandatory written reason, recorded on the audit trail.

parameters.name: target_status
parameters.description: Defaults to 'In Progress'. Must be 'Pending' or 'In Progress' (also 'Submitted' for an Embassy step_type).

post.summary: Record a Kuwait LMIS step's Police Ashara sub-check
post.description: New (2026-09-12). Kuwait LMIS step_type only. Records the appointment/status/payment/remark for the Police Ashara sub-check, mirroring record_wakala_payment's Embassy-only Wakala fields. Replaces the previous only-way-to-change-it: a raw desk-form field edit with no role gate beyond blanket Clearance Step write access, no validation, and no audit trail.

parameters.name: police_ashara_remark
parameters.description: Required if police_ashara_status is set to 'Failed'.

post.summary: Record or correct a miscellaneous payment on a Clearance Step
post.description: New (2026-09-12). Adds a new row (or, with payment_row_name, corrects an existing one) in a Clearance Step's generic "Other Payments" table -- any fee not already covered by a dedicated field (Wakala, Police Ashara, Injaz), e.g. an insurance premium. Works for any step_type. Replaces the previous only-way-to-change-it: a raw desk-form child-table edit with no role gate beyond blanket Clearance Step write access, no validation, and no audit trail.
x-roles: Anyone holding the role mapped to this step_type

parameters.name: payment_type
parameters.description: Required when recording a new payment (payment_row_name not passed), e.g. 'Insurance'.

parameters.name: payment_row_name
parameters.description: Pass the existing child row's name to correct it instead of appending a new row.

post.summary: List the current user's Clearance Step queue
post.description: A Clearance Officer/Ticketer's own ToDo-scoped queue, or -- for the six country+step roles -- every row of their matching step_type.
x-roles: Any authenticated staff user (results scoped by role)

post.summary: Reassign a Clearance Step to a different officer
post.description: The escape hatch for the default auto-chain assignment. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

parameters.name: new_officer
parameters.description: User email

post.summary: Mark an Embassy step Rejected (Thursday, failure outcome)
post.description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. A written rejection_remark is required. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

post.summary: Mark an Embassy step Stamped (Thursday, success outcome)
post.description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

parameters.name: override_reason
parameters.description: Manager/Admin/System Manager only: push the Stamp through despite an unpaid Wakala fee, with a mandatory written reason logged to the audit trail (Process Event).

post.summary: Mark a Clearance Step In Progress
post.description: Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).
x-roles: Anyone holding the mapped country+step role

post.summary: Submit an Embassy step's documents (Monday)
post.description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. Pending -> Submitted. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3). New (2026-09-11): also blocked (417) for a Saudi-corridor Embassy step whose Wakala fee isn't yet Paid, unless the caller is Manager/Admin/System Manager AND passes override_reason -- see record_wakala_payment for the normal way to clear this.

parameters.name: override_reason
parameters.description: Manager/Admin/System Manager only: push the submission through despite an unpaid Wakala fee, with a mandatory written reason logged to the audit trail (Process Event).

post.summary: Record the Saudi Embassy step's Wakala fee payment
post.description: New (2026-09-11). Saudi corridor Embassy step_type only -- Kuwait's own "Kuwait Embassy" step_type doesn't carry a Wakala fee. Paid by the foreign agency (Contractor), not internal staff -- this endpoint just records that it landed, and is what clears the submit_embassy_step Wakala-unpaid block for this step. Replaces the previous only-way-to-change-it (a raw desk-form field edit with no role gate beyond blanket Clearance Step write access, no validation, no audit trail) -- this endpoint gates on the same actionable-step rule as submit/stamp/reject_embassy_step and logs a Process Event.

parameters.name: paid_date
parameters.description: Defaults to today when wakala_status is set to Paid; ignored otherwise.

post.summary: New -> Unresolved
Log a complaint against a placed worker
post.description: A Foreign Agency can only complain about their own placement; internal staff need a recognized staff role.

post.summary: List Unresolved complaints, oldest-first
post.description: So nothing quietly sits forgotten at the bottom of a list.

post.summary: Resolve a complaint (Resolved / Free Replacement / Escalated / Dismissed)
post.description: Dismissed requires a written resolution_notes. override_reason (Manager Override) widens permission to include plain Manager for that one call.

post.summary: Extract structured fields from an uploaded contract
post.description: Saudi: contract#/visa#/employer/agency/salary. Kuwait: employer/site/duration/salary only (its template carries far less). Returns mock fixture data instead of real OCR when Document Parsing Settings.use_mock_parsing is on.
x-roles: Any authenticated user (called internally by placement_api.upload_contract, not typically called directly)

post.summary: Extract fields from a Kuwait eVisa document
post.description: visa_number/type/dates/reference, sponsor name+civil ID, Kuwait agency name+license.

post.summary: Get the ordered step definitions for a destination country's corridor
post.description: Data-driven -- adding a new corridor (e.g. a third country) is purely a Corridor Definition doc, no code change.

post.summary: Generate and attach the official Agency CV PDF
post.description: Standard track, Registered status only. Renders via a Frappe Print Format, mirrors to Cloudflare R2 (falls back to a local private file if Storage Settings isn't configured). Moves the Applicant to CV Generated. Refused (403) if the applicant has an active country ban on their destination_country, unless a Manager/Admin overrides or an approved Country Ban Request pass exists -- CV Generated is what makes an applicant visible in the agency portal. Refused (417, no override) if the applicant's medical_status is UNFIT.

parameters.name: override_ban
parameters.description: Manager/Admin/System Manager only, to push past an active country ban on the applicant's destination_country

parameters.name: override_reason
parameters.description: Required if override_ban is true

403.description: Not permitted, or the applicant is actively banned from their destination_country (Applicant Country Ban) -- retry as Manager/Admin with override_ban + override_reason

post.summary: Approve a Pending transaction
post.description: Pending -> Approved via the sanctioned transition() path. Only Approved entries count toward ledger/balance totals.

post.summary: Batch a contractor's owed commissions for settlement
post.description: Batches a contractor's owed commissions (one currency per batch) into a new Commission Batch Request. transaction_names selects which owed commissions to include; omit it to batch everything currently owed for the contractor/country (pass currency too if that pool spans more than one). include_unpaid_from_previous (2026-09-12, "include unpaid from previous") additionally folds in any still-unpaid items sitting in this contractor's other open batches (Sent/Partially Settled) in the same currency, releasing them from their old batch and making them real, per-item-trackable line items on this new one -- not just a cosmetic number on the printed invoice.

parameters.name: transaction_names
parameters.description: JSON array of specific transaction names; omit to batch everything owed

parameters.name: requested_advance_amount
parameters.description: Up-front ASAP ask recorded on the batch (Birr), separate from advance received

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Required if transaction_names is omitted and the owed pool spans multiple currencies, or if include_unpaid_from_previous is used without transaction_names covering exactly one currency.

parameters.name: include_unpaid_from_previous
parameters.description: Also carries over still-unpaid items from this contractor's other open (Sent/Partially Settled) batches in the same currency into this new batch.

post.summary: Set or change the advance requested on an existing batch
post.description: New (2026-09-12). Finance Manager/Admin/System Manager. create_commission_batch only lets requested_advance_amount be set at creation time -- this is the endpoint for adding one afterward or correcting it. Deliberately simple: just a number added into the printed invoice total (Batch Total + requested_advance_amount + previous unpaid), no reference number, no received-date, no settlement-math linkage. Pass 0 to clear a previously-set advance.

parameters.name: requested_advance_amount
parameters.description: In the batch's own currency. Pass 0 to clear.

post.summary: Get the cached FX rate for a currency
post.description: ETB is hardcoded to 1.0 (Birr itself, no conversion needed). Other currencies fall back to the most recent cached rate on or before as_of_date; throws if none was ever recorded.

post.summary: List a contractor's owed (unbatched, Approved) commissions
Log an expense
post.description: Open to any internal staff role -- Finance Manager/Admin approval (approve_transaction) is the real gate, not who's allowed to log. placement is optional (general office expenses are loggable too). Do NOT use this for LMIS/Kuwait LMIS/Telesign/Taeshir/Embassy/Kuwait Embassy clearance-step costs (stage set to one of those step types) -- those are known-in-advance fees configured on Corridor Definition.known_fees, and since 2026-09-23 each is recorded automatically as its own already-Approved expense when its clearance step completes; a manual log here would double-count them. Still the right endpoint for genuinely ad-hoc costs (reschedule fees, general office expenses, anything not in known_fees).

post.summary: Log income
post.description: Same shape/permissions as log_stage_expense. Same caveat applies: don't use this for LMIS/Kuwait LMIS/Telesign/Taeshir/Embassy/Kuwait Embassy clearance-step costs -- those are auto-logged (as Expense, not Income) from Corridor Definition.known_fees when each clearance step completes. See log_stage_expense's description.

post.summary: Reject a Pending transaction
post.description: Pending -> Rejected. A written rejection_reason is required.

post.summary: Manually record an FX rate
post.description: Custom-mode path (FX Rate Settings). ETB cannot be set -- it's always 1:1, hardcoded. Recording a rate also converts every awaiting_fx_rate transaction in that currency (the transaction's own-date rate if one exists on/before it, else the earliest rate after it). Already-converted transactions are never recomputed.

fx_rate.description: The new FX Rate record's name (a hash), NOT the rate value -- call get_fx_rate to read the value back.

post.description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): explicit multi-select manual settlement, alongside upload_batch_payment_proof's parser. Batch status becomes Partially Settled until every item is Paid.

parameters.name: item_names
parameters.description: JSON-encoded list of Commission Batch Item child row names.

post.description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): best-effort parse + fuzzy name match against the batch's own item list. Unmatched names stay Pending for manual settle_batch_items review -- never blocks.

post.summary: Render a Commission Batch invoice PDF on demand
post.description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): applicant names + amounts, built fresh whenever requested, not pre-generated/stored at batch creation.

Manually trigger commission accrual early
post.description: For cases needing to bill sooner than Departed. Idempotency-guarded -- calling this then later reaching Departed naturally is a no-op the second time.

post.description: Approved -> Voided, via transition(). No hard delete, ever -- the row stays visible with its status flagged. A written void_reason is required.

post.description: Every alert currently true for anything the calling user can see (see notification_feed.py), stamped with that user's own read/dismissed state -- this is what a new device now sees identically to any other device, instead of everything showing as if new.

post.summary: Dismiss or restore a single alert for the current user
post.description: state="Dismissed" to dismiss, state="Read" to restore. Always writes for the session user only -- never accepts a user parameter.

post.description: Drives the manual 'enable notifications' fallback button.

post.summary: Send a real test push notification to the current user
post.description: Exercises the actual delivery pipeline (Comms Log -> pywebpush), not a client-side-only Notification() call -- proves whether server-to-device push genuinely works.

post.summary: Subscribe the current browser to Push notifications
post.description: A user subscribing their own browser -- never on behalf of anyone else.

post.description: The escape hatch alongside the automatic Fri/Sat/Sun watchdog. Embassy steps only.

post.description: ICAO 9303 checksum self-correcting MRZ parser (TD3/TD1), falls back to visual OCR. Never raises -- returns {} on failure.

parameters.description: Page size, clamped to 1-500. Blank/0 = 100.

parameters.description: If true, the response is {"data": [...], "total_count": N} instead of a bare list. total_count uses the same filters and permission scope as the rows.

post.description: The direct/manual advance. override_reason attempts a Manager Override if the move is gate-blocked.

post.description: Muayena enters directly at Selected with contract in hand -- no portal, no CV. Contractor is always picked manually.

parameters.name: file_url
parameters.description: Optional signed contract to parse immediately

post.summary: Record a ticket reschedule
post.description: reschedule_date is the new flight date (flight_date moves with it). Airport: the airline moved the flight -- nothing is paid or recorded. Internal: we rescheduled, so a new ticket is bought -- reschedule_cost (ETB) is REQUIRED and recorded as its OWN auto-Approved expense (fee_type 'Ticket (Internal Reschedule)'), one per reschedule; its name is returned as reschedule_transaction. ticket_number, if sent, replaces the placement's ticket number. To correct an Internal reschedule's price, call again with transaction=<that reschedule_transaction> and the corrected reschedule_cost (reschedule_date/cause not needed) -- the same row is edited. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled.

parameters.name: reschedule_date
parameters.description: New flight date. Required unless correcting via transaction.

parameters.name: reschedule_cause
parameters.description: Required unless correcting via transaction.

parameters.name: reschedule_cost
parameters.description: ETB. Required when cause=Internal (and when correcting). Ignored for Airport.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional; must be ETB if sent.

parameters.name: ticket_number

Same sheet name (Bio_Applicant_Details), same 13 columns/order/widths/header colour (#9999FF)/date format (d/mmm/yyyy), plus the template's hidden 'hiddenSheet' nationality list, so the result drops into the downstream authority's upload with no manual reformatting. Not one of this app's own branded reports (no title row/autofilter/frozen header) -- shifting anything from row 0 = headers would break the receiving end's parser. The template's in-cell dropdowns/validation (Gender, Nationality, name checks) are not reproduced; the values written already come from validated Applicant fields. Column 'E.No' is the applicant's Injaz Application ID, taken from the Taeshir step of their latest non-Cancelled placement (the Active Injaz attempt, else the last one); it is blank if they have no Taeshir step or no ID yet. Column 'Email ID*' is the agency's own email from Agency Tracking Settings > Agency Email (same value printed on the Injaz PDF), not the applicant's. Throws a clear ValidationError listing any not-found applicant names rather than silently dropping them (zero-data-loss convention).

post.summary: Columns of one clearance-step grid, with which ones the caller may edit
post.description: Excel-like clearance grid (client #11). Returns [{field,label,type,options,editable}] -- read-only info columns (step, applicant, passport, placement status...) plus this step_type's editable columns. `editable` is for the calling user: management and the step_type's own role edit everything; LMIS applicant columns (national_id, labor_id, coc_status, exam_date, emergency contact) need an LMIS role or Manager/Admin; a Clearance Officer edits only rows assigned to them (enforced on save). The status column's options are forward moves only -- going back is reopen_clearance_step (reason popup), never a cell.
x-roles: Any internal staff; editability varies by role

post.summary: Rows of one clearance-step grid (step + applicant + current Injaz attempt), paged
post.description: One row per Clearance Step of step_type, oldest first, with applicant columns joined (full_name, passport_number; on LMIS grids also the LMIS applicant fields), Taeshir's current Injaz attempt (injaz_application_id, appointment_date, injaz_payment_status, injaz_paid_date, injaz_outcome), Wakala / Police Ashara fields, and `modified` + `applicant_modified` -- send `modified` back with each changed row so a row edited by someone else meanwhile is refused instead of overwritten. Steps of Departed/Cancelled placements are hidden unless include_closed=1. Same row scoping as other Clearance Step lists.
x-roles: Any internal staff (rows scoped by role)

parameters.description: Default 100, max 500

post.summary: Save many rows' changed cells; each cell runs the same action as its button
post.description: changes = [{name, modified, fields:{column: value}, override_reason?}] (max 200 rows; send only changed cells). Every cell goes through the real action -- status -> start/complete/submit/stamp/reject, Wakala -> record_wakala_payment, Injaz paid -> record_injaz_payment, appointment/Injaz ID -> set_taeshir_appointment, Police Ashara -> record_police_ashara, LMIS applicant fields -> update_applicant_for_lmis -- so fees, gates (Injaz Paid before Taeshir Complete, Wakala Paid before Submit/Stamp, Taeshir Complete before Stamp), notifications and audit log are identical to the buttons. Within a row, data cells apply before the status move, so 'Injaz Paid + Complete' or 'Wakala Paid + Submitted' work in one save. Rejected needs rejection_remark in the same row. Moving a step backwards is refused (use reopen_clearance_step). Each row is all-or-nothing and independent. Result per row, in order: {name, ok:true, row} or {name, ok:false, error, field, conflict?, row} -- `row` is the current grid row either way; conflict=true means the row changed after it was loaded (reload it). override_reason = Manager/Admin override for Wakala unpaid at Submit/Stamp.
x-roles: Management; the step_type's own role; Clearance Officer on assigned rows

parameters.name: changes
parameters.description: JSON list of row changes
